zh.title: 全球第三繁忙貨運機場（SDF）SDF 擬建10億美元國際旅客航站
zh.summary: SDF擬建10億美元國際旅客航站樓；利用UPS Worldport既有設施
body: 據Simple Flying報道，全球第三繁忙的貨運機場正籌建一座耗資10億美元的國際旅客航站樓。報道稱，該機場（路易斯維爾穆罕默德·阿里國際機場，SDF）並非從零新建國際航站樓，而是利用UPS Worldport四十年來的機場空地過度建設，這些設施已規劃好跑道規模。
報道標題指出，該機場爲「世界第三繁忙貨運機場」，但未提供具體客流量或建設時程等細節，也尚未說明航站樓的啓用時間或航班安排。

en.title: 3rd-Busiest Cargo Airport Builds $1B International Passenger Terminal
body: According to Simple Flying, the world's third-busiest cargo airport is quietly building a $1 billion international passenger gateway. The report states that the airport at Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport (SDF) is not building an international concourse from scratch; instead, it is monetizing four decades of UPS Worldport airfield overbuild that already sized runway.

The report does not provide further details such as passenger capacity, timeline, or airlines. The information remains based on this single report. Ground handling and runway infrastructure are mentioned but no specific milestones are offered.
en.summary: World's 3rd-busiest cargo airport SDF building $1B international passenger gateway; key airport is established by UPS overbuild
